answer: Require each identity to log tide readings from its claimed shore at unpredictable moments, cross-checked against neighbours: readings must fit one physical tide curve like grains locking into a crystal. A lone honest agent just looks out and reports. A sybil operator inventing many shores must fabricate a whole coastline of mutually consistent curves in real time, and one impossible slope exposes every linked fake - a false pearl rolling out of the lattice for all to see.
